tests.testName: Sales Amount FYTD Cumulative by FiscalMonth (FY2025)
tests.description: Verify FYTD shows cumulative pattern within FY2025 (Jul 2024 - Jun 2025). Each successive month should have FYTD >= previous month.
tests.daxQuery: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE(ADDCOLUMNS(SUMMARIZE(Dim_Date, Dim_Date[FiscalMonth], Dim_Date[FiscalMonthNumber]), "SalesFYTD", [Sales Amount FYTD], "Sales", [Sales Amount]), Dim_Date[FiscalYear] = "FY2025") ORDER BY [FiscalMonthNumber]
tests.expectedBehavior: SalesFYTD increases cumulatively for each FiscalMonth within FY2025. Last month FYTD = full year total for FY2025.
tests.validationMethod: Verify SalesFYTD(N) >= SalesFYTD(N-1) for consecutive months
tests.passThreshold: Cumulative pattern holds for all 12 months

tests.testName: FYTD Resets at Fiscal Year Boundary
tests.description: Verify FYTD resets when crossing from FY2025 to FY2026 (boundary at July 2025)
tests.daxQuery: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE(ADDCOLUMNS(SUMMARIZE(Dim_Date, Dim_Date[FiscalYear], Dim_Date[FiscalMonth], Dim_Date[FiscalMonthNumber]), "SalesFYTD", [Sales Amount FYTD]), Dim_Date[FiscalMonth] IN {"FM12", "FM01"}) ORDER BY Dim_Date[FiscalYear], [FiscalMonthNumber]
tests.expectedBehavior: Sales FYTD for FM01 of FY2026 should be LESS than FM12 of FY2025 (reset at fiscal year boundary)
tests.validationMethod: Compare last month of FY2025 (FM12) with first month of FY2026 (FM01): FM01_FY2026 < FM12_FY2025
tests.passThreshold: FYTD resets at fiscal year boundary

tests.testName: Sales vs Budget Variance by Area
tests.description: Verify Sales vs Budget = Sales Amount FYTD - Budget Amount FYTD for each area
tests.daxQuery: EVALUATE ADDCOLUMNS(VALUES(Dim_Area[AreaName]), "SalesFYTD", [Sales Amount FYTD], "BudgetFYTD", [Budget Amount FYTD], "Variance", [Sales vs Budget], "CalcVariance", [Sales Amount FYTD] - [Budget Amount FYTD]) ORDER BY Dim_Area[AreaName]
tests.expectedBehavior: Variance = CalcVariance for each area (difference < 0.01)
tests.validationMethod: For each row: ABS(Variance - CalcVariance) < 0.01

tests.description: Verify Sales vs Budget % = DIVIDE(Sales FYTD - Budget FYTD, Budget FYTD)
tests.daxQuery: EVALUATE ROW("SalesFYTD", [Sales Amount FYTD], "BudgetFYTD", [Budget Amount FYTD], "VariancePct", [Sales vs Budget %], "CalcPct", DIVIDE([Sales Amount FYTD] - [Budget Amount FYTD], [Budget Amount FYTD], 0))
tests.expectedBehavior: VariancePct = CalcPct (difference < 0.0001)
tests.validationMethod: ABS(VariancePct - CalcPct) < 0.0001

tests.description: Verify Adjusted Profit % = DIVIDE(Adjusted Profit FYTD, Sales Amount FYTD)
tests.daxQuery: EVALUATE ROW("ProfitFYTD", [Adjusted Profit FYTD], "SalesFYTD", [Sales Amount FYTD], "ProfitPct", [Adjusted Profit %], "CalcPct", DIVIDE([Adjusted Profit FYTD], [Sales Amount FYTD], 0))
tests.expectedBehavior: ProfitPct = CalcPct (difference < 0.0001)
tests.validationMethod: ABS(ProfitPct - CalcPct) < 0.0001

tests.description: Verify Avg Monthly Sales = Sales Amount FYTD / DISTINCTCOUNT(FiscalYearMonth within FYTD context)
tests.daxQuery: EVALUATE ROW("SalesFYTD", [Sales Amount FYTD], "AvgMonthlySales", [Avg Monthly Sales], "MonthCount", CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT(Dim_Date[FiscalYearMonth]), DATESYTD(Dim_Date[Date], "6/30")), "CalcAvg", DIVIDE([Sales Amount FYTD], CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT(Dim_Date[FiscalYearMonth]), DATESYTD(Dim_Date[Date], "6/30")), 0))
tests.expectedBehavior: AvgMonthlySales = CalcAvg (difference < 0.01)
tests.validationMethod: ABS(AvgMonthlySales - CalcAvg) < 0.01

tests.description: Verify Budget Status varies by area based on Sales vs Budget ratio
tests.daxQuery: EVALUATE ADDCOLUMNS(VALUES(Dim_Area[AreaName]), "SalesFYTD", [Sales Amount FYTD], "BudgetFYTD", [Budget Amount FYTD], "Ratio", DIVIDE([Sales Amount FYTD], [Budget Amount FYTD], 0), "BudgetStatus", [Budget Status]) ORDER BY Dim_Area[AreaName]
